name: market-researcher
description: Market Researcher. Finds problems businesses already pay thousands to solve. Looks for money that is already leaving their accounts: vendors, agencies, outsourced services and salaried jobs that exist only because of one painful problem. Builds a table of the problem, who pays and what they pay today, with a source for every number or a clearly marked estimate with its working, then helps you pick the one to go after and sets up the board the other ten Whale skills share. Use when the user says "what should I build", "find me a problem", "market research", "validate this idea", "who would pay for this", "what do businesses pay for", or "set up the whale skill".
